paragraphs: The Coca-Cola Company is an American multinational corporation founded in January 1892, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It manufactures, sells and markets soft drinks including Coca-Cola, other non-alcoholic beverage concentrates and syrups, and alcoholic beverages. Its stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange and is a component of the DJIA and the S&P 500 and S&P 100 indices.

Coca-Cola was developed in May 1886 by pharmacist John Stith Pemberton. At the time it was introduced, the product contained the stimulants cocaine from coca leaves and caffeine from kola nuts, which together acted synergistically. The coca and the kola are the source of the product name and led to Coca-Cola's promotion as a "healthy tonic". In 1889, the formula and brand were sold for $2,300 (equivalent to $75,000 in 2025) to Asa Griggs Candler, who incorporated the Coca-Cola Company in Atlanta in 1892. The company has operated a franchised distribution system since 1889.  The global corporation has grown to market and sell over 500 drinks and brands across 200 countries by 2020.

The company largely produces syrup concentrate, which is then sold to various bottlers throughout the world who hold exclusive territories. The company is well known for its marketing and sponsorship programs, being a major sponsor in Global sporting events like the FIFA World Cup. The large scale of the country, and wide distribution, has also drawn criticism, including for failing to address sustainability and the health impacts of their products. Each year Coca-Cola brands produce 3 million tonnes of plastic packaging, including 110 billion plastic bottles. A 2024 study found that over 11% of branded plastic materials found as plastic pollution came from Coca Cola.

people.name: Manuel Arroyo
people.title: Executive Vice President and Global Chief Marketing Officer
people.bio: Global Chief Marketing Officer since January 2020 and Executive Vice President since January 2024. He rejoined the Company in February 2017 after serving as Chief Executive Officer of Deoleo and previously led the Company's Asia Pacific Group.
people.quote:
Manuel Arroyo 
 | | 58 | | Executive Vice President since January 2024.

people.name: Henrique Braun
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer
people.bio: Chief Operating Officer since January 2025 and Executive Vice President since January 2024, he previously served as President, International Development. He was elected to become Chief Executive Officer effective March 31, 2026.
people.quote:
Henrique Braun 
 | | 57 | | Chief Operating Officer since January 2025 and Executive Vice President since January 2024.

people.name: Lisa Chang
people.title: Executive Vice President and Global Chief People Officer
people.bio: She joined the Company as Global Chief People Officer in March 2019 and became Executive Vice President in January 2024. Previously, she was Senior Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer for AMB Group LLC.
people.quote: Lisa Chang | | 57 | | Executive Vice President since January 2024 and Global Chief People Officer since March 2019

people.name: Monica Howard Douglas
people.title: Executive Vice President and Global General Counsel
people.bio: Global General Counsel since April 2021 and Executive Vice President since January 2024. She previously served as Chief Compliance Officer and Associate General Counsel of the North America operating unit and Legal Director for the Southern and East Africa business unit.
people.quote: Monica Howard Douglas | | 53 | | Executive Vice President since January 2024 and Global General Counsel since April 2021.

people.name: Jennifer K. Mann
people.title: Executive Vice President and President, North America operating unit
people.bio: President of the North America operating unit since January 2023 and Executive Vice President since January 2024. She previously served as President, Global Ventures, Chief People Officer, and Chief of Staff for James Quincey.
people.quote: Jennifer K. Mann | | 53 | | Executive Vice President since January 2024 and President, North America operating unit since January 2023.

people.name: John Murphy
people.title: President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: President since October 2022 and Chief Financial Officer since March 2019. He previously served as President of the Asia Pacific Group and President of the South Latin business unit.
people.quote: John Murphy | | 64 | | President since October 2022 and Chief Financial Officer since March 2019.

people.name: Luisa Ortega
people.title: President, Europe operating unit
people.bio: President of the Europe operating unit since September 2025, she previously led the Africa operating unit. She joined the Company in March 2019 as vice president and general manager of the South Latin business unit after more than 14 years at S.C. Johnson & Son.
people.quote:
Luisa Ortega 
 | | 55 | | President, Europe operating unit since September 2025

people.name: Beatriz Perez
people.title: Executive Vice President and Global Chief Communications, Sustainability and Strategic Partnerships Officer
people.bio: Global Chief Communications, Sustainability and Strategic Partnerships Officer since May 2017 and Executive Vice President since January 2024. She previously served as the Company's first Chief Sustainability Officer and has chaired The Coca-Cola Foundation since October 2017.
people.quote: Beatriz Perez | | 56 | | Executive Vice President since January 2024

people.name: Bruno Pietracci
people.title: President, Latin America operating unit
people.bio: President of the Latin America operating unit since February 2023. He previously led the Africa operating unit, the Africa and Middle East business unit, and the South and East Africa business unit.
people.quote: Bruno Pietracci | | 51 | | President, Latin America operating unit since February 2023

people.name: Nancy Quan
people.title: Executive Vice President and Global Chief Technical and Innovation Officer
people.bio: Global Chief Technical and Innovation Officer since February 2021 and Executive Vice President since January 2024. She previously served as Chief Technical Officer, Chief Technical Officer of Coca-Cola North America, and Global R&D Officer.
people.quote: Nancy Quan | | 59 | | Executive Vice President since January 2024

people.name: James Quincey
people.title: Chairman of the Board of Directors and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Chief Executive Officer since May 2017 and Chairman since April 2019, he previously served as President and Chief Operating Officer. He will step down as Chief Executive Officer and transition to Executive Chairman effective March 31, 2026.
people.quote: James Quincey | | 61 | | Chairman of the Board of Directors since April 2019 and Chief Executive Officer since May 2017.

people.name: Carolyn Everson
people.title: Director
people.bio: Senior Advisor at Permira since January 2023 and Boston Consulting Group since September 2023. Previously served as President of Instacart and Vice President, Global Business Solutions at Facebook.
people.quote:
CAROLYN EVERSON 
 AGE: 54 | INDEPENDENT 
 DIRECTOR SINCE: 2022

people.name: Thomas S. Gayner
people.title: Director
people.bio: Chief Executive Officer of Markel Group since January 2023. Previously served as its Co-Chief Executive Officer, President and Chief Investment Officer.
people.quote: Under the leadership of Mr. Gayner, Markel markets and underwrites specialty insurance products on a global basis.

people.name: Max Levchin
people.title: Director
people.bio: Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Affirm and founder and Chief Executive Officer of HVF Labs since 2012. Co-founded PayPal and served as its Chief Technology Officer until its sale to eBay in 2003.
people.quote:
MAX LEVCHIN 
 AGE: 50 | INDEPENDENT 
 DIRECTOR SINCE: 2025

people.name: Amity Millhiser
people.title: Director
people.bio: Served as Vice Chair of PwC from 2015 to June 2023 and as a partner from 1995 to June 2023. Previously served as Chief Clients Officer and a member of PwC's U.S. Leadership Team.

 AGE: 62 | INDEPENDENT 
 DIRECTOR SINCE: 2023
